data.action: 浴衣并肩牵手走过摊位，烟花亮起时侧头微笑
data.camera: medium two-shot, festival crowd, hand holding, firework glow
data.description: 紫藤花纹的浴衣衬着忍的笑靥，苹果糖的甜香混在祭典的喧嚣里。人潮涌动的路口，她自然而然地把手递给你——「人潮里牵着就不会走散了。……嗯？脸红什么，只是防走失措施而已哦？……啊，烟花开始了。不快点看的话，就要错过了。」
data.lighting: 灯笼暖光与远处烟花的冷艳
data.promptProse: Shinobu wears a lavender wisteria-patterned yukata and turns back with a small smile as she takes her companion's hand. He has cropped black hair and a dark teal yukata with narrow vertical stripes. They walk through the crossing in warm lantern light, with the festival crowd soft behind them and a cool flash from the fireworks overhead.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 夏祭夜路的并肩
data.animaCaption: Shinobu's purple-tipped hair and lavender floral yukata catch the fireworks as she reaches for the short-haired man's hand. He wears a dark teal striped yukata, beside her in front of the distant crowd.
